name: Baconsistent
description: StartPos consistency trainer with profiles and an experimental in-level stage editor.

enabled.name: Enable Baconsistent
enabled.description: Track repetitions only when the current level has been explicitly bound to a saved StartPos profile.

repetitions.name: Repetitions per part
repetitions.description: Default repetitions for every fixed stage. Individual stages can override this target from the pause menu.

auto-previous.name: Move backwards automatically
auto-previous.description: When a part reaches its target, select the previous unfinished part. This follows the recommended 90-100 -> 80-90 -> ... order.

auto-match-start.name: Match start position
auto-match-start.description: When an attempt starts near any detected StartPos boundary, automatically select that exact part.

strict-start.name: Require exact small runs
strict-start.description: Only count a part if the attempt started near that part's beginning. Disable this if you want runs from earlier percentages to count too.

start-tolerance.name: Start tolerance (%)
start-tolerance.description: How close an attempt start must be to the selected part boundary.

practice-mode-protection.name: Practice Mode protection
practice-mode-protection.description: When enabled, attempts that use Practice Mode are ignored completely and do not affect progress or statistics.

noclip-protection.name: Noclip protection
noclip-protection.description: When enabled, a run is ignored only if GD attempts a lethal collision and noclip keeps the player alive. Merely having noclip enabled does not block a clean A-to-B run.

manual-add-repetition.name: Add repetition
manual-add-repetition.description: Add +1 repetition to the currently active stage.

manual-complete-stage.name: Complete stage
manual-complete-stage.description: Set the currently active stage to its target.

theme-preset.name: Theme
theme-preset.description: Choose the Baconsistent UI preset. Turkmenistan, Udmurtia and Tatarstan are intentionally over-the-top joke themes.

custom-colors.name: Custom colors
custom-colors.description: Override the selected theme's main UI colors with your own palette.

pause-startpos-progress.name: Show StartPos progress on pause
pause-startpos-progress.description: Replace the Practice Mode progress area while paused with the active StartPos repetition counter and remaining runs.

success-notifications.name: Show successful-run notifications
success-notifications.description: Show a short branded notification whenever the active fixed StartPos stage is successfully counted. Mastered stages and completed rounds get special notifications.
